question:
The following graph represents the production of electric scooters (in thousands) for the years 2020 and 2021 from five manufacturers P, Q, R, S, and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d529738eee4a0f944d89293e93fa08e49d0bf849d7b48bd18ee7f028d44a55.png] 

The ratio of the average production by all manufacturers in 2021 to the average production by all manufacturers in 2020 is:
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average production = (Total production) / (Number of manufacturers)

**Calculations:**

Total production in 2020 = 6 + 12 + 14 + 20 + 13 = 65

Average production in 2020 = 65 / 5 = 13

Total production in 2021 = 16 + 17 + 14 + 15 + 23 = 85

Average production in 2021 = 85 / 5 = 17

Ratio of the average production in 2021 to the average production in 2020 = 17 : 13

**Therefore, the ratio of the average production by all manufacturers in 2021 to the average production by all manufacturers in 2020 is 17 : 13.**
